bump_behavior.aligned: size multiple of 8: result = old cursor; cursor += size; remaining -= size
bump_behavior.shared_with_grow: the grow path reuses this bump with the grow size as the available amount, so a grow smaller than the size wraps the remaining literally
bump_behavior.unaligned: size not a multiple of 8: result = cursor + (remaining - size); cursor untouched; remaining -= size

callees_by_contract.0x5f07200: post-direct callee, called with (this) after the direct top carve or the slow call in refill; internals not modelled
callees_by_contract.0x5f0b5e0: guard release, called with a stack lock slot in cleanup; internals not modelled
callees_by_contract.0x605d6c0: slow allocator, mapped by the arena packet; called with (member at this + 0x60, size, 0) on the global short path and the direct-refill short path
callees_by_contract.0x605d7b0: AllocateAligned, mapped by the arena packet; called with (member at this + 0x60, grow, 0, 0) on the grow path
callees_by_contract.0x605e170: shard refresh, called with (this) when a shard lock byte is set; internals not modelled

census_notes.confirmation: every census site was confirmed by the per-byte .text scan method of the neighbouring packets; the RELATIVE entry was additionally decoded directly
census_notes.qword_hit: file offset 0x10bef8 is the addend field of the RELATIVE entry at file offset 0x10bee8 for slot 0x64cc5e8 (type 8, addend 0x5f11c40), not a separate reference
census_notes.vtable: the window is the third virtual of the outer class vtable 0x64cc5d8 (slots 0x5f10180, 0x5f10d00, 0x5f11c40, 0x5f117a0, 0x5f04da0); it is reached only through that slot, hence no direct call or tail-jump site

cleanup_behavior.cleanup: the global lock byte is cleared on one pad route; the guard-release callee 0x5f0b5e0 (by contract) is called on the shard-lock slot and/or the global-lock slot per the held flags; then unwinding resumes

arguments: rsi = size (raw, no rounding, no quantum)
entry_behavior.route: TLS-shard path only when (field + 0x40) >> 2 >= size; otherwise the global-lock path

fallback_behavior.attempt: otherwise try the global lock: success takes the global-lock path body, a lost race retries the shard selection
fallback_behavior.condition: cpuid zero and shard-0 remaining zero
fallback_behavior.flag_set: global-lock flag already set: throw system_error code 0x23 (35); unreachable from this entry, since the flag is zero on this route
fallback_behavior.null_lock: global-lock slot null: throw system_error code 1

fields.field40_0x40: qword at this + 0x40; entry gate uses (field >> 2), grow size uses the raw field
fields.gate_pair_0x888_0x8a8: member fields at this + 0x888 and + 0x8a8; equality selects the direct refill path
fields.gate_pair_0x8d8_0x8f8: member fields at this + 0x8d8 and + 0x8f8; equality is the second direct-refill gate
fields.global_lock_0x950: lock byte at this + 0x950, spun on with PAUSE and sched_yield after 100 pauses
fields.member_940_0x940: member field at this + 0x940, snapshot source for this + 0x960
fields.member_arena_0x60: member arena object at this + 0x60, the AllocateAligned/slow receiver
fields.member_counter_0x918: member field at this + 0x918, snapshot source for this + 0x968
fields.member_current_cursor_0x920: current-block cursor at this + 0x920; top-carved (decreases by the size)
fields.member_current_remaining_0x930: current-block remaining at this + 0x930, snapshot source for this + 0x958
fields.shard_array_0x48: pointer at this + 0x48; shard entries are 64-byte structs from this base
fields.shard_shift_0x50: byte at this + 0x50; shard index masks the cpuid to its low (shift & 63) bits
fields.snap_remaining_0x958: snapshot field at this + 0x958, compared against the size in refill
fields.tls_cpuid_slot: fs:0 - 0x408; holds the cpuid value used for shard selection
fields.tls_gate_got_0x64ed7e8: GOT slot; nonzero gates the TLS getter call 0x63f13b0

global_behavior.carve: top carve: result = cursor - size; cursor -= size; remaining -= size; snapshots refreshed (this + 0x958 <- this + 0x930, this + 0x960 <- this + 0x940, this + 0x968 <- this + 0x918); global lock byte cleared
global_behavior.lock: spin on byte at this + 0x950: PAUSE loop, sched_yield once the pause counter passes 100, LOCK CMPXCHG of 1
global_behavior.slow: remaining short: slow callee 0x605d6c0(member at this + 0x60, size, 0), then the same snapshot refresh and lock clear; the slow result is returned

grow_size_note: literal rule from the mov/shr/cmp/cmovb shape, shared with the sibling window 0x5f117a0: the cmovb only replaces F with S while S < 2 * F, so the third arm keeps F. The sibling packet's summary states 2 * F for that arm; the excerpt bytes in both packets show F.

refill_behavior.direct_condition: snapshot remaining (this + 0x958) >= size AND member gate pair (this + 0x888) == (this + 0x8a8) AND second gate pair (this + 0x8d8) == (this + 0x8f8)
refill_behavior.direct_effect: current remaining (this + 0x930) >= size: top carve exactly like the global path, then callee 0x5f07200(this) (by contract); global lock byte cleared, shard lock byte cleared, carved pointer returned with the shard cursor/remaining untouched
refill_behavior.direct_slow: current remaining short: slow callee 0x605d6c0(member, size, 0), then callee 0x5f07200(this), both locks cleared, slow result returned
refill_behavior.grow_effect: fresh block = AllocateAligned(member, g, 0, 0) via 0x605d7b0, stored as the shard cursor; the three snapshot fields are refreshed from the member fields; the global lock is cleared; the bump then runs from the fresh block with the grow size as the available amount
refill_behavior.grow_size: F = field + 0x40, S = snapshot remaining: g = F when S < F >> 1, g = S when F >> 1 <= S < 2 * F, g = F when S >= 2 * F
refill_behavior.lock: global lock at this + 0x950 acquired with the same PAUSE/yield/CMPXCHG spin

tls_behavior.cpuid: TLS slot fs:0 - 0x408; the TLS getter 0x63f13b0 runs first only when GOT slot 0x64ed7e8 is nonzero
tls_behavior.cpuid_zero: when the cpuid value is zero, shard-0 remaining (array + 0x38) is checked: zero takes the fallback path, nonzero continues with shard 0
tls_behavior.index: index = cpuid & ((1 << (shift & 63)) - 1), or 0 when shift & 63 == 0; entry = array + index * 64
tls_behavior.locked_shard: a shard whose lock byte is set is refreshed by callee 0x605e170(this) (by contract); its return becomes the shard entry, then the entry lock is spun on
tls_behavior.lost_race: a failed LOCK CMPXCHG on an entry lock re-runs the refresh callee 0x605e170

unknowns: the meaning of field + 0x40 beyond its gate/grow roles, and of member fields + 0x940, + 0x888, + 0x8a8, + 0x8d8, + 0x8f8
why the direct refill path leaves the shard cursor/remaining untouched
the exact semantics of the GOT slot 0x64ed7e8 gate on the TLS getter
the LSDA call-site table for the three landing pads
